headline: Supreme Court Orders Karthigai Deepam Lighting In Tamil Nadu
seoTitle: Supreme Court Orders Karthigai Deepam In Tamil Nadu
metaDescription: The Supreme Court mandated that CRPF oversee the Karthigai Deepam lighting at Tirupparankundram Hill following disputes with the Tamil Nadu government.
aiSummaryBullets: The Supreme Court issued contempt notices to Tamil Nadu officials regarding the failure to facilitate the lighting of a lamp on Tirupparankundram Hill.
Central Reserve Police Force personnel have been directed to oversee the Karthigai Deepam lighting ceremony to ensure compliance with court orders.
State political figures have exchanged criticism, with the BJP alleging an anti-Hindu stance by the state administration while officials review legal options.
aiContextParagraph: The controversy centers on the annual Karthigai Deepam festival lighting atop Tirupparankundram Hill in Tamil Nadu. The Supreme Court intervened after the state government allegedly failed to implement previous directives to allow the traditional lamp lighting ceremony. In response to the impasse, the court has ordered the Central Reserve Police Force to secure the site and oversee the event. The state government is currently reviewing its legal position in light of these developments. Tensions have risen as political factions, including the Bharatiya Janata Party, have publicly criticized the state administration for their perceived interference in religious traditions. This legal dispute coincides with other administrative activities in the region, such as the Governor flagging off a special train for the Kashi Tamil Sangamam and ongoing investigations into security threats, underscoring a period of heightened scrutiny for state governance and religious management.
whyItIsViral: The story is highly viral, covered by four independent media outlets with a very rapid pace of reporting following the Supreme Court's intervention.
